newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rye, barley offered into German grain intervention.
newsitem.headline: Rye, barley offered into German grain intervention.

text.p: Some 33,472 tonnes of feed rye and 23,973 tonnes of barley have been offered to the German intervention board (BLE) over the past week, a BLE source said on Monday.
The size of offers made a huge build-up of stocks in the November-May intervention campaign look unlikely, traders said.
Relatively large rye and barley volumes were offered in the states of Saxony and Thuringia.
Total 1996/97 grain offers still lagged those in the same 1995/96 period -- 1,011,970 tonnes by April 18 compared with 1,670,440 a year earlier.
The April buying-in price for all grains in 245.83 marks.
